title: HTML-to-text extractor skips script/style, decodes entities, breaks blocks
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag dropping empty lines as losing meaningful blank-line formatting, or an unclosed script swallowing trailing text as a bug. Whitespace-only separation is not content under the stated plain-text contract, and text after an unclosed script is script text by HTML parsing rules, so excluding it is the safe and correct reading.
